offering_description.value: Provides health savings account custody, administration and benefits platforms to employers, health plans and their employees, earning fees on accounts, transactions and services across the US.

primary_products.value: health savings accounts; health reimbursement accounts; benefits payment cards; benefits management platform

primary_services.value: account administration; COBRA administration; investment management for accounts; benefits enrollment support

customer_segment.value: B2B: employers, health plans, benefits brokers and consultants; B2C: individual employees and members holding health savings accounts

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: fees per card transaction and account activity; service fees: account administration and benefits platform fees paid by employers; commissions or management fees: fees on invested account balances; interest or premiums: interest income on account cash balances
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; service fees; commissions or management fees; interest or premiums

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: holds and custodies health savings account assets for account holders; service provider: administers accounts and benefits for employers and health plans; software / platform: benefits platform used by employers and members, sold to employers and plans
value_chain_position.category: financial intermediary; service provider; software / platform

geography_served.value: US national: Serves employers and members across all US states

specialization.value: related lines: health savings accounts, health reimbursement accounts, COBRA administration, benefits payment cards

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling to large national employers; partners / resellers: health plans, benefits brokers and consultants that refer employers; online: online member portal and mobile app for account holders

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: IRS rules for HSAs, ERISA, HIPAA privacy and state trust company oversight

notes: Business mix and account counts change over time; the description reflects my general knowledge.
